packs-with-cover-note.cause: The piece counter counted the cover note, the thank-you and the sign-off as pieces: 6 found where 3 were needed. Fixed: when the pieces have titles, what comes before the first and after the last isn't counted.

returns-policy-pdf.cause: The check "under 250 words in total" is about the whole delivery, so there was no line to quote, and a pass without a quote counts as a fail. Fixed: code now measures facts about the delivery as a whole (its kind, pages, size, words in total), and a pass can quote one.

bakery-image.cause: The check "image is square" had nothing to quote either, and code didn't measure the image. Fixed: code reads the image's width and height and gives them as a fact.

yoga-site-link.cause: The checker saw the page's words but wasn't told they came from a link that loaded, so it failed "delivered as a working link". Fixed: the link and its HTTP status are facts.

faq-as-a-table.cause: The piece counter didn't know tables and counted the whole table as one piece of 185 words. Fixed: a table is one piece per row.
